ValidationRule.description: This rule will fire if user enters a special character (*&?%). A validation rule on the Drive Field on the Blood Drive Opportunity object mimics this one.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Keywords are recommended to be 50 letters or less. Keywords should begin by being letter based. They may have numbers after words; i.e. Bulldog2018, not 2018Bulldog Keywords should not allow special characters (*&?%)
